subject: Future Tech
title: Off-Target Effects
description: Learn Off-Target Effects in one minute.

hook.text: CRISPR sometimes cuts DNA at the wrong location. These off-target edits can silently damage genes the patient needs.

buildup.text: A guide RNA that's slightly imperfect may bind to similar sequences elsewhere in the genome and trigger unintended cuts.

discovery.text: Whole-genome sequencing can detect off-target edits, but checking every cell in a patient's body is not feasible.

twist.text: An off-target cut in a tumor suppressor gene could trigger cancer. The very tool meant to heal could cause new disease.

climax.text: High-fidelity Cas9 variants and better guide design have reduced off-target rates dramatically but not to absolute zero.

punchline.text: Precision editing must be precise or it's just a new risk.

quiz.question: What could an off-target CRISPR cut in a tumor suppressor gene cause?
